# NFL Daily — 2026-11-23 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- The 49ers released WR Brandon Aiyuk, ending his tumultuous tenure in San Francisco; the 2020 first-rounder will hit waivers before becoming a free agent. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575346/sources-49ers-releasing-wr-brandon-aiyuk)
- The 49ers signed GM John Lynch to a contract extension. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575248/source-49ers-gm-john-lynch-agree-contract-extension)
- The Cardinals fired defensive coordinator Nick Rallis; senior defensive assistant Teryl Austin takes over on an interim basis. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575938/cardinals-fire-defensive-coordinator-nick-rallis-sources-say)
- The Ravens lost their sixth straight, 35-33 to the Panthers, as coach Jesse Minter took blame for a late clock-management blunder and a defense that still can’t get a stop. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7804625/2026/11/22/ravens-jesse-minter-blame-panthers-loss/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Chargers QB Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday’s loss to the Jets. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/justin-herbert-concussion-protocol-update-jets/)
- Patriots QB Drake Maye remains out with a fractured right fibula; coach Mike Vrabel confirmed Tommy DeVito stays QB1 rather than seeking outside help. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575341/mike-vrabel-patriots-sticking-tommy-devito-qb1)
- 49ers RT Colton McKivitz is out for the season with a fractured and dislocated ankle suffered against the Vikings. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50568995/49ers-colton-mckivitz-exits-game-vs-vikings-injuring-lower-leg)
- Rams TE Terrance Ferguson will have season-ending ankle surgery and stays on IR. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50575889/rams-te-terrance-ferguson-needs-season-ending-ankle-surgery)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-23 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- The Ravens fell to the Panthers 35-33, their sixth straight loss, as four turnovers — including a game-ending Jacoby Brissett interception — left Baltimore at 4-7 and, per the team site, in a "dire situation." [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-sixth-straight-loss-carolina-self-inflicted-wounds-dire-situation-defensive-issues-breakdown-week-11)
- Coach Jesse Minter took the blame for the loss, pointing to his own late clock-management decision on a key fourth down and a pass defense that again couldn’t get a needed stop. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7804625/2026/11/22/ravens-jesse-minter-blame-panthers-loss/)
- Safety Kyle Hamilton said there’s a "trust" breakdown within the Ravens defense, now six games into the losing streak. [Jonas Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2124619103822655965)
